mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate hydroxyzine's CNS depressant effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and mental status closely; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte replacement during concurrent use; consider alternative anxiolytic if severe renal impairment develops.
